{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicate patient_id rows, keeping the one with highest sample_seq
# This ensures we have one row per patient
data = data.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Now check shape and confirm
print("After deduplication (one row per patient):")
print("Shape:", data.shape)
print("Patient count:", data['patient_id'].nunique())

# Replace sentinel values with NaN in biomarker_baseline
data['biomarker_baseline'] = data['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Check for missingness in baseline
print("\nMissing baseline biomarker:", data['biomarker_baseline'].isna().sum())

# Check if biomarker_final is missing
print("Missing final biomarker:", data['biomarker_final'].isna().sum())

# Compute change in biomarker
# Only for non-missing baseline and final
data['biomarker_change'] = data['biomarker_final'] - data['biomarker_baseline']

# Check distribution of change
print("\nBiomarker change (baseline to final):")
print(data['biomarker_change'].describe())

# Check response rate by arm
print("\nResponse rate by arm:")
print(data.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean())

# Check response rate by severity
print("\nResponse rate by severity:")
print(data.groupby('severity')['responded'].mean())

# Check response rate by arm within each severity level
print("\nResponse rate by arm within severity:")
print(pd.crosstab(data['arm'], data['severity'], margins=True, normalize='index'))"}
